title: Banana Pancakes
hookLine: United States-inspired banana pancakes with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Banana Pancakes
steps.instructionTemplate: In a bowl, mash the banana with a fork until it resembles a thick purée. Stir in the eggs, baking powder and vanilla. Keep {m52855_1}, {m52855_2}, {m52855_3}, and {m52855_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure banana first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m52855_5}, {m52855_6}, and {m52855_7} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat a large non-stick frying pan or pancake pan over a medium heat and brush with half the oil. Using half the batter, spoon two pancakes into the pan, cook for 1-2 mins each side, then tip onto a plate. Repeat the process with the remaining oil and batter. Top the pancakes with the pecans and raspberries.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {m52855_5}, {m52855_6}, and {m52855_7}. Serve Banana Pancakes fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
